svg.title: From the calibration to total biomass
svg.desc: Three panels. First, the canopy mapped across a site as imaged at a tide height. Second, the same canopy corrected for tide, larger because canopy hidden by the tide is added, and capped at the site's water area. Third, the overall calibration read at full cover gives the biomass per square metre of canopy. Total biomass is that value times the corrected canopy area.
svg.text: At the tide height of the imagery.
Total biomass (kg) = kg per m² of canopy (3) × corrected canopy area, m² (2)
